svg.title: Shock profiles at exact sensor-arrival time
svg.desc: Exact and three finite-volume density profiles on the frozen N=50 synthetic LWR case, with the sensor and operational density threshold marked.

g.text: A cell-average norm can look exact while the operational front is smeared
Synthetic backward LWR shock; N=50; grey line is the fixed sensor and dashed black line is rho=0.8.
